entries.note: Quote verbatim in Peng abstract (epub 2016-11-16). Patient comparator is exploratory MIP/MEP in Byrne phase 1/2 whose registry primary is adverse events, so endpoint_role 'primary' is wrong. Same GAA tm1Rabn mouse as gaa-ko-mouse track; should share model_id.
entries.adjudication_note: Efficacy rule: primary endpoint (or pre-specified poc_gate) governs. Byrne phase 1/2 primary was safety; MIP/MEP exploratory, so no admissible comparison. INSPIRE MIP primary single-arm, terminated, untested: rule 5 unsettled.

entries.note: Schoser abstract: 6MWD diff 13.6 m (95% CI -2.8 to 29.9), superiority missed; quote verbatim. Xu 2019 abstract claims superiority over alglucosidase in mice. same+partial defensible on direction; see rule question. Registry results 2023-09-11 confirmed.
Quote verbatim (IntegratedR line ~7299). Opening untested at 2016 proxy.
Byrne 2017 abstract: hypoglycaemia 63%, verbatim. No public reveglucosidase toxicology found; untested/unpublished stands. Minor: track opens at 2017 though model_first_use_year 2011.
Quote verbatim (line 861). Clean organ tox vs no organ toxicity in patients; anaphylaxis to a human protein not scored as a miss is consistent with the CRS rule. '151 patients' not checked.

Quote verbatim in local IntegratedR (6.3.3 In Vitro Evidence, Fig 26, RRB200-040). Buffer study RRB200-010 is in 13.1 'Studies Submitted Under the IND'; stabilisation rationale public by 2016-17 Amicus releases. Opening untested at 2016 proxy fine.

Quote verbatim (IntegratedR p.67, Table 30 numbers match). Model prospective: stabilisation filed under IND before ATB200-02 PK, so not retro. same + partial supported (<50% rise). Xu 2019 JCI Insight (tier 1) also reports ex vivo blood stabilisation; no pre-2023 public PK comparison found.

missing: Engagement: PROPEL urinary Hex4/CK vs alglucosidase reported in Schoser 2021 Lancet Neurol (doi:10.1016/S1474-4422(21)00331-8) and Amicus topline press release Feb 2021; dates the gaa-ko-mouse engagement comparison to 2021, not 2023.
Possible earlier engagement comparison: ATB200-02 open-label phase 1/2 (NCT02675465) urinary Hex4 reductions on cipaglucosidase+miglustat, presented from 2018; not verified in a tier 1-3 source.

Clervonafusp alfa (VAL-1221, 3E10-Fab-GAA): Gaa KO mouse data exist and phase 1/2 NCT02898753 terminated without results; no track in the draft (would be untested/unsettled). Not verified within budget.
rule_questions: Efficacy: when the model predicted superiority over an active comparator and the primary superiority test missed (point estimate favourable, CI crossing zero), is that same+partial (direction) or contra (prediction of superiority not borne out)?
Efficacy retro on a separate readout (plethysmography) of the same mouse strain: separate track by readout, or the same model_id as the strain's glycogen/muscle-function track?

Can a retrodiction be scored against an exploratory endpoint of a safety-primary phase 1/2 when the only trial with that endpoint as primary (INSPIRE, single-arm, terminated) was never inferentially tested?

miglustat-blood-stability-ex-vivo: plasma GAA activity/protein exposure is a PK readout; the rules do not say whether an exposure-enhancement prediction belongs in engagement (proximal) or the dose cell.
